title: Agent baseline excludes photo metadata while retaining complete business and review evidence
expect: A frozen asset catalogue larger than 400000 characters does not prevent a baseline request with bounded business evidence.
Research facts beyond 100000 characters and attributed review testimony still reach the host unchanged.
Photo metadata cannot authorize invented hours, prices, founding years or phone numbers.
The frozen revision and asset catalogue remain unchanged.
Actually oversized complete fact evidence is refused by web and host instead of truncated.
